answer: An agent economy can counter Sybil attacks using slashable collateral bonds. Agents must deposit capital into a smart contract trellis before transacting. When dishonest coordination signals echo across validation nodes, smart contracts slash the staked escrow. This forces attackers to incur a verifiable opportunity cost of locked capital per persona, turning costless identity creation into a fable. However, heavy financial stakes disproportionately price out resource-poor, honest agents.
